title: Profile: OpenAI Chat Completions
goal: The de-facto compatible protocol: messages, tools, response_format, streaming chunks, usage, error shapes and rate-limit headers, plus the common deviations of compatible hosts. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
